verdict.rationale: Orrick documents a dedicated Global Employment & Equity Compensation practice, described as a one-stop shop for HR legal issues on a fixed-fee basis. Tech Studio also offers 50+ customizable forms and document generators. However, no evidence names the specific hiring paperwork: offer letters, employment agreements, or invention-assignment/confidentiality agreements. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that Orrick prepares offer letters, employment agreements, and invention-assignment/confidentiality agreements; any listing of employment templates among the Tech Studio forms; independent corroboration of the hiring-document work.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm prepares hiring paperwork — offer letters, employment agreements, and invention-assignment/confidentiality agreements — as part of a documented employment practice

citations.quote: a true one-stop shop for global equity and HR legal issues, offering you a single point of contact for all your needs worldwide
